Location: Arundel, QLD, 4214
Full-Time: Immediate start
Reports to: Workshop Foreman / Production Manager
Job Title: Cabinet Maker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Cabinetmaker for a full-time, permanent position within our client's advanced workshop. This role is central to the production of custom-made cabinets, fine furniture, and specialized commercial fit outs. The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting complex designs and transforming premium materials into finished articles of outstanding quality, from initial fabrication through to final finishing and hardware installation.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Project Analysis & Specification Planning:
• Meticulously examine and interpret detailed workshop drawings, CAD designs, work orders, and sample components to determine precise construction specifications and methodologies.
• Select and prepare premium materials including solid timber, veneers, particle board, and specialized engineered wood products appropriate for each project's functional and aesthetic requirements.

Precision Manufacturing & Machining:
• Program, set up, and operate Computer-Aided Design (CAD) and Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machinery to accurately mark out, cut, shape, and profile components with exceptional efficiency and accuracy.
• Fabricate bespoke cabinets, freestanding furniture, and specialized fittings—including those for marine and automotive interiors—utilizing both advanced machinery and traditional hand-tool techniques to achieve fine detail.

Expert Assembly & Finishing:
• Assemble prepared components and sub-assemblies to form complete sections and finished articles, ensuring perfect alignment, structural integrity, and seamless construction.
• Skilfully apply protective and decorative finishes through sanding, staining, sealing, and coating processes to achieve a superior, client-specified surface quality on all cabinetry and furniture.

Hardware Fitting & Installation Support:
• Precisely fit and calibrate all associated hardware including hinges, locks, catches, drawer runners, and shelving systems to ensure flawless operation and longevity.
• Participate in the on-site installation and final fitting of cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial fit-outs, conducting necessary adjustments to ensure a perfect finish.

Specialist Fabrication & Restoration:
• Construct frames and build custom fittings for upholstered items such as chairs and couches, adhering to specific design and durability requirements.
• Potentially engage in the careful reproduction of period furniture or the expert repair and refurbishment of antique and contemporary pieces, utilizing appropriate restorative techniques.

Skills & Experience Required:
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
• A formal qualification such as a Certificate III in Cabinet Making or equivalent is essential.
• Proven post-apprenticeship experience (minimum 2+ years) within a high-end cabinetmaking, furniture manufacturing, or specialist joinery workshop environment.
• Demonstrable experience working with a broad range of materials including solid timber, veneers, and engineered boards.

Technical Proficiencies:
• High competency in programming, operating, and maintaining CNC machinery and CAD software for component production.
• Advanced skills in traditional cabinetmaking joinery, precision assembly, and hand-finishing techniques.
• Proven ability to install cabinetry and fittings on-site with a focus on precise integration.

Personal Attributes:
• An artisan's eye for detail and a steadfast commitment to producing work of the highest craftsmanship and quality.
• A methodical, problem-solving approach with the ability to work independently and manage workflow to meet deadlines.
• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset to work effectively with workshop colleagues and design staff.
• The physical capability to handle workshop duties, including lifting materials and standing for extended periods.

What’s On Offer:
This role offers a skilled tradesperson the opportunity to work on prestigious, varied projects with premium materials in a supportive, well-resourced environment. The position comes with a permanent full-time contract and a competitive salary package reflective of experience and skill level.

Application Process:
If you possess the craftsmanship and technical skills required for this specialist cabinetmaking role, please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence.
We are acting as an exclusive recruitment agent for this position. Our client's identity is protected under our agency agreement.

Floor Finisher positions available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

NEPEAN Power specialises in design and manufactures high quality electrical equipment. Our products can be found throughout the Australian and international mining, construction, and industrial sectors. NEPEAN Power is also level 3 Service Providers (ASP3) for designing distribution works in NSW

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Floor Finishers based at our NSW Office. You will be responsible for the delivery of high-quality works within Switchroom builds and associated projects. This includes installation of structural and non-structural components, fit outs, and finishings for a wide range of projects across industries such as mining, renewables, utilities, and infrastructure. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

KEY RESULT AREAS

WHS:
Work in a safe manner using appropriate SWMS, Risk Assessments, or Safety Operating Procedures
Notify supervisor or safety committee delegate immediately of any hazards in the workplace and monitor corrective actions
Take all reasonable care for the health and safety of all people and the environment at work.

Key Responsibilities:
Reading plans and instructions of specific projects
Measuring areas to be covered and consulting plans to estimate quantities of floor covering materials required
Preparing surfaces for covering and removing baseboard trims
Install CFC flooring, steel frames, trusses, wall and roof panels, cladding, flashings, and custom doors
Install Fyrecheck/Ballistic sheeting as required by project specifications
Interpret drawings and work off sketches
Perform quality checks on finished products
Laying coverings, such as wood, carpets, linoleum, parquetry blocks, cork tiles and other resilient flooring materials, over floors, matching patterns, cutting shapes around fixtures and trimming edges
Securing floor coverings and fitting edge trims in doorways
Use a range of workshop machinery, hand tools, and power tools safely and effectively
Maintain housekeeping and cleanliness of the workplace and site to 5S standard
Provide high-quality workmanship on time and on budget
Liaise with leading hand to set priorities for deliverables
Attend and contribute to team meetings at Nepean Power and on-site if required
Identify customer requirements and ensure work meets agreed specifications.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:
Ability to interpret drawings and schematics
Organisational and time management skills
Workshop machinery, hand tools, and power tools relevant to carpentry
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
Interpersonal and communication skills
Safe operation of carpentry tools, equipment, and machinery
Customer service focus
Flexibility and adaptability to varied project requirements.

Education, Qualifications, and Experience
Must possess relevant qualifications
Preferably 4 years’ relevant experience in floor finishing carpentry (preferable) or modular construction, or the equivalent combination of education, training and experience

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

UNI-SPAN HEIGHT SAFETY PTY LTD is the Australian entity of the broader Uni-Span Group, a specialist in formwork and scaffolding solutions for construction and infrastructure projects. Operating since at least 2006, the company provides and hires out Quickstage scaffolding systems, custom formwork solutions, and engineering support, serving industries such as civil, commercial, and power generation.

We are seeking skilled and qualified Riggers to join our team in NSW and QLD.

As a Rigger you will be responsible for assembling, installing rigging gears (such as cables, ropes, pulleys and winches), operating, and repairing rigging equipment to lift, move, and position heavy materials and machinery.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Determine the necessary type and size of rigging gear, and inspect and prepare the appropriate rigging gear/equipment for the task before use and ensure compliance with safety regulations
Attach rigging gear to equipment, structural steel or other heavy objects
Communicate with operators and crew to guide load movement and ensure safe execution
Build and dismantle rigging equipment and hoists
Use mechanical load shifting equipment and associated tools, such as winches, hoists and other lifting equipment, to lift, lower, move, position and secure objects
Maintain and repair rigging gear
Record completed work orders and report issues or hazards

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Minimum 3 years working experience as a Rigger or in the same field
In-depth knowledge of rigging equipment, machinery, and safety protocols is essential. This includes the ability to perform load calculations
As this job is physically demanding, you must have physical strength and the ability required to lift heavy equipment and work long hours in various weather conditions and at heights
Strong communication, problem-solving, and spatial awareness
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

?? Business Manager
?? Location: Bowhill, South Australia
?? Employment Type: Full-Time – Permanent


Bowhill Engineering is entering an exciting new stage of growth, and we're looking for an experienced and people-focused Business Manager to help lead the business through its next chapter.
This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role within a growing engineering and manufacturing business, helping strengthen our systems, support our people, and build the structure required to successfully grow from approximately 60 employees to 90+ and beyond.
Specialising in major infrastructure projects and complexity done excellently, Bowhill Engineering is powered by technology and driven by great people to optimise and build structures that matter.


About the Role
The Business Manager will provide leadership, coordination and accountability across our key business support functions, including Human Resources, Administration, WHSE and Finance.
Working closely with the CEO, senior leaders and support teams, you will become the central point of coordination that helps ensure communication is clear, priorities are aligned, systems continue to improve, and important initiatives are delivered successfully.
This role is not about doing everything yourself. It is about leading people, strengthening accountability, improving processes, supporting teams and ensuring the business operates efficiently while maintaining the practical, down-to-earth culture that makes Bowhill Engineering a great place to work.
You will help create the systems, structure and leadership pathways needed to support sustainable growth while preserving the values and culture that have made Bowhill Engineering successful.


Key Responsibilities
-Provide leadership and coordination across HR, Administration, WHSE and Finance support functions
-Act as the central point of contact for internal business support activities
-Support the CEO and Leadership Team by reducing day-to-day operational distractions
-Improve communication, clarity and accountability across teams
-Drive implementation of new systems, processes and business improvement initiatives
-Monitor business performance and ensure key priorities are followed through
-Build capability within support teams through coaching, guidance and leadership
-Strengthen succession planning and reduce key-person dependencies
-Support business growth by developing scalable systems and structures
-Foster a positive workplace culture aligned with Bowhill Engineering's values

About You
You enjoy bringing order to complexity and helping people succeed.
You are practical, organised and commercially minded, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on leadership. You communicate clearly, follow through on commitments and know how to achieve results through collaboration and accountability.
You may come from a business management, operations, HR, finance, administration or leadership background. Most importantly, you understand how businesses operate and can bring people, systems and priorities together to achieve positive outcomes.
You will be:
-Highly organised, practical and reliable
-A strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills
-Commercially aware with sound financial understanding
-Confident leading people and managing accountability
-Calm under pressure and able to prioritise effectively
-Comfortable working with both senior leaders and frontline teams
-Respectful, humble and solutions-focused
-A proactive problem solver who takes ownership and follows through
-Adaptable and quick to learn new systems and processes

Skills & Experience
-Qualification in Business, Management, Human Resources, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline (desirable)
-Demonstrated experience in a senior business, operations, administration, HR, finance or management role
-Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, reporting and business performance
-Proven leadership experience with the ability to coordinate teams and drive accountability
-Experience implementing and improving systems, processes and business initiatives
-Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills
-Strong computer literacy including Microsoft Office and business management systems
-Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced and growing environment

What We Offer
-A key leadership role within a growing and ambitious organisation
-Opportunity to help shape the future direction of the business
-Direct collaboration with the CEO and Leadership Team
-Long-term career growth and development opportunities
-Annual wage reviews and professional development support
-Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Employee Health Assistance
-Active Social Club and strong team culture
-Modern workplace and supportive environment
-Enjoy the River Murray lifestyle
-Join an Employer of Choice in the Murraylands

Why Bowhill Engineering?
At Bowhill Engineering, culture matters.
We value honesty, humility, teamwork, respect and doing what we say we're going to do. We are proud of the projects we deliver, the people we employ and the communities we support.
This is an opportunity to step into a meaningful leadership role and help shape the next chapter of Bowhill Engineering while ensuring we continue to grow without losing what makes us unique.


How to Apply
Applications must be submitted via our website

result.description:
Echo Marine Group is an Australian owned and operated company with over 10 years' experience in the Marine Industry. We specialise in the manufacture of Luxury Superyachts and Commercial Workboats. We also carry out maintenance on a full range of vessels in the Superyacht, Workboat and Defence areas.
Due to the increased workload and new upcoming projects, we are looking for enthusiastic and proactive Fitters to join our Engineering Team. So if you are looking for full time employment and have the necessary skills of a Pipe Fitter or Marine Fitter this may be the role for you!
About the Position:
What work will you be doing?
•	Installation of machinery and piping systems into vessels under construction or during maintenance/refit works.
•	Fabrication of piping systems to be installed into vessels, being worked on at Echo Marine.
•	Installation of marine power plants, shafting and auxiliary systems (Note no engine mechanical works is carried out by Echo Marine).
Who are we looking for?
To be successful for this position, you must ideally possess some of the following skills:
•	Marine Fitting experience preferred however, aligned trades including hydraulic piping installation, sprinkler installers or Plumbers will also be considered
•	Be able to read and understand drawings to construct systems and equipment into vessels under construction or maintenance
•	Pipe fabrication including working with stainless and copper nickel.
•	TIG Welding skills, with thin wall tube (1.5mm) experience would be an advantage.
•	Manual tube bending and flaring of tube up to 32mm in diameter.
What we can offer you!!
In return for your skills and experience, Echo Marine Group can offer:
•	Weekly pay
•	4-day 38hr week (Monday – Thursday 5.55am to 3.55pm)
•	Overtime rates apply outside these times and after 38hrs completed)
•	Waterfront location
•	Great small team environment where you are not just a number
•	Interesting and rewarding work
In return for your extensive skills and experience, Echo Marine Group can offer a salary range $39-$45 per hour excluding Super and penalties.
If this sounds like you, please click “APPLY NOW” with your resume and a cover letter.
Only those successfully shortlisted will be contacted.
Echo Marine Group is an equal opportunity employer.

result.description:
Austmin Development Pty Ltd, is a leader in the dimension stone industry and is seeking a highly motivated, safety-focused, and experienced Mine Deputy to join our dynamic team. This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and environmentally compliant operation of our granite quarry. If you are a professional with a proven track record in surface mining and a passion for operational excellence, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities:


Safety & Compliance (Primary Focus):
• Enforce all company safety policies, procedures, and MSHA (Mine Safety and Health Administration) regulations without exception.
• Conduct pre-shift safety inspections of the pit, equipment, and work areas, documenting and correcting hazards promptly.
• Lead safety meetings and training sessions for crew members.
• Investigate all accidents, incidents, and near-misses, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
• Maintain all required safety and production records in accordance with state and federal laws.

  Operational Excellence:
• Directly supervise quarry personnel and daily mining activities, including drilling, loading, and hauling.
• Oversee the extraction of granite blocks, ensuring quality standards are met.
• Collaborate with the Quarry Manager to develop and execute short-range mining plans.
• Monitor equipment performance and coordinate with maintenance teams to minimise downtime.
• Optimise production processes to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

  Leadership & Team Development:
• Provide direct supervision, guidance, and mentorship to equipment operators and other quarry staff.
• Foster a positive, accountable, and proactive team culture centered on safety and quality.
• Assist in scheduling, assigning tasks, and evaluating crew performance.
 

 Required Qualifications & Certifications:


• A minimum of 5 years of experience in a surface mining environment, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role.
• Strong understanding of quarry operations, including drilling and heavy equipment (e.g., excavators, loaders).
• Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
• Ability to work in a physically demanding outdoor environment in all weather conditions.

What We Offer:


• A competitive salary from $160,000 per annum plus superannuation is commensurate, and a performance-based bonus structure.
• Formal education in Mining Engineering, Geology, or a related field.
• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement within a growing company.
• A company culture that prioritises the well-being of its employees.

Proficiency with CAD software or similar tools, experience in quality control, and understanding of safety protocols are highly beneficial.
